requirements.label: Introductory Biology Sequence
requirements.hint: Choose Sequence A, B, or C. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Sequence A: BIOLOGY 171, 172 or 174, and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 171, one of BIOLOGY 172 or BIOLOGY 174, and BIOLOGY 173. 3 courses total.

requirements.label: Sequence B: BIOLOGY 195 (AP) and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 195 (AP credit) plus BIOLOGY 173. 2 courses total.

requirements.label: Sequence C: BIOLOGY 191 (transfer), 192, and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 191 (transfer credit), BIOLOGY 192, and BIOLOGY 173. 3 courses total.

requirements.label: Chemistry Sequence: CHEM 210 & 211
requirements.hint: CHEM 210 (Structure and Reactivity I) and CHEM 211 (Investigations in Chemistry).

requirements.label: Chemistry Sequence: CHEM 215 & 216
requirements.hint: CHEM 215 (Structure and Reactivity II) and CHEM 216 (Synthesis and Characterization of Organic Compounds).

requirements.label: Quantitative Analysis Sequence
requirements.hint: Choose 4 courses from the approved list, per the Program in Biology Microbiology Major Requirements guide (updated 8/22/2025): MATH 115/120/185/275/295; MATH 116/121/156/186/276/296; Physics I (PHYSICS 125/135/139/140/150/160); Physics II (PHYSICS 126/235/239/240/250/260); computer programming (EECS 183/203/280); statistics (STATS 180/206/250/280, and any STATS course 400-level or above with at least 3 credits); BIOLOGY 202; BIOLOGY 131 (cross-listed BIOPHYS 131 / COMPFOR 131); DATASCI 101; or BIOPHYS 290 / PHYSICS 290. A course used here cannot also count as a major elective.

requirements.label: Biochemistry
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: MCDB 310, BIOLCHEM 415, or CHEM 351

requirements.label: Advanced Lab 1: MCDB 429 or EEB 447/401
requirements.hint: MCDB 429 (Laboratory in Cell and Molecular Biology), EEB 447, or the Environmental Microbiology section of EEB 401.

requirements.label: Advanced Lab 2: 1 course from approved list
requirements.hint: Choose 1 course, per the Program in Biology Microbiology Major Requirements guide (updated 8/22/2025): 3 credits of independent research (MCDB 400, EEB 400, INTMED 400, MICRBIOL 399, or EPID 399); MCDB 306; EPID 504; EPID 545; BIOPHYS 450; or a second MCDB 429 or EEB 447 if not already used for Lab 1. Independent research must be at least 3 credits in one term, and at most 3 research credits count toward the major.

requirements.label: Group 1: Specified Electives, 4 courses
requirements.hint: Choose at least 4 courses (minimum 12 credits) from the approved Group 1 list, per the Program in Biology Microbiology Major Requirements guide (updated 8/22/2025): EARTH 413; EEB 315; EEB 325 (cross-listed CMPLXSYS 325); EEB 416 / MCDB 416; EEB 447 (or EEB 401 Environmental Microbiology section) if not used for an advanced lab; EEB 446; EEB 468; EPID 460; MCDB 408; MCDB 409 / MICRBIOL 409 / INTMED 409; MCDB 415; MCDB 436; MCDB 464; MCDB 472; MCDB 489; MICRBIOL 405; MICRBIOL 415; MICRBIOL 430; MICRBIOL 440; or MICRBIOL 460 / INTMED 460. Only one of MCDB 436 and MICRBIOL 440 counts toward the major.

requirements.label: Major Credits: minimum 31 credits
requirements.hint: The 31 credits come from the courses used for the major: core (BIOLOGY 207, BIOLOGY 305, and the biochemistry choice), the two advanced labs, and Group 1 plus Group 2 electives from the approved lists, per the Program in Biology Microbiology Major Requirements guide (updated 8/22/2025). Prerequisites, introductory science courses, and non-specific (departmental) transfer courses are excluded. Two Group 2 categories are open-ended and also count: any MATH course with MATH 116 as a prerequisite, and any STATS course at the 400 level or above, when not used for the Quantitative Analysis prerequisite. At most 3 credits of independent research count, and only one of MCDB 436 and MICRBIOL 440 counts.
